   - **vla-object-51** (bjb1-32546 GPU2) — 95%, ~10 min
   - **crm-long-48/49** (bjb1-32546 GPU4) — 85%, ~20 min
   - **p25-seed44** (bjb2-40593 GPU0) — 85%, ~20 min
